answer: WITH s AS (SELECT p.sitekey, p.sitelabel, (e.elec_perf_snapshot->'power'->>'power_now_w')::numeric AS pn, (e.elec_perf_snapshot->'power'->>'power_loss_w')::numeric AS pl, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY p.sitekey ORDER BY pr.snapts DESC) AS rn FROM plant_record pr JOIN plants p ON p.sitekey = pr.sitetie JOIN electrical_performance e ON e.snaplink = pr.snapkey WHERE e.elec_perf_snapshot->'power'->>'power_now_w' IS NOT NULL AND e.elec_perf_snapshot->'power'->>'power_loss_w' IS NOT NULL AND (e.elec_perf_snapshot->'power'->>'power_now_w')::numeric + (e.elec_perf_snapshot->'power'->>'power_loss_w')::numeric <> 0) SELECT sitelabel, ROUND(pn * (1 - pl / (pn + pl)), 2) AS effective_power FROM s WHERE rn = 1 ORDER BY effective_power DESC

SELECT LOWER(pm.pnlkind) AS panel_kind, AVG(((e.elec_perf_snapshot->'iv_curve'->>'vmp_initial_v')::numeric - (e.elec_perf_snapshot->'iv_curve'->>'vmp_now_v')::numeric) / (e.elec_perf_snapshot->'iv_curve'->>'vmp_initial_v')::numeric) AS avg_voltage_degradation_factor FROM electrical_performance e JOIN plant_record pr ON pr.snapkey = e.snaplink JOIN plants p ON p.sitekey = pr.sitetie JOIN panel_models pm ON pm.modkey = p.modhook WHERE e.elec_perf_snapshot->'iv_curve'->>'vmp_initial_v' IS NOT NULL AND e.elec_perf_snapshot->'iv_curve'->>'vmp_now_v' IS NOT NULL AND (e.elec_perf_snapshot->'iv_curve'->>'vmp_initial_v')::numeric > 0 GROUP BY LOWER(pm.pnlkind) ORDER BY avg_voltage_degradation_factor DESC
SELECT SUM(pm.degyrrate::numeric / 100 * 400000 * 50 * 15) AS total_lifetime_revenue_loss FROM plants p JOIN panel_models pm ON pm.modkey = p.modhook WHERE pm.degyrrate::numeric * 20 > 14
note: ADR taken as the panel model's specified annual degradation rate (percent, divided by 100); one row per plant via plants.modhook.

answer: WITH s AS (SELECT o.maintcost::numeric AS mc, o.mtbfh::numeric AS mtbf, o.mttrh::numeric AS mttr, EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (pr.snapts - p.goliveon::timestamp)) / 3600.0 AS total_h FROM operational_metrics o JOIN plant_record pr ON pr.snapkey = o.snapops JOIN plants p ON p.sitekey = pr.sitetie) SELECT AVG(mc / (total_h / mtbf)) AS avg_mean_repair_cost FROM s WHERE mtbf > 0 AND total_h > 0 AND mttr / (mtbf + mttr) > 0.05
note: No snapshot has MTTR/(MTBF+MTTR) above 0.05 (max 0.04), so this returns NULL.

answer: SELECT sitelabel, warrclaims FROM plants WHERE LOWER(warrstate) = 'claimed' AND warrclaims > 2 ORDER BY warrclaims DESC

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT pr.sitetie) FROM plant_record pr JOIN mechanical_condition m ON m.snapmk = pr.snapkey WHERE LOWER(m.mech_health_snapshot->'electrical_integrity'->>'grounding_status') = 'failed' OR LOWER(m.mech_health_snapshot->'electrical_integrity'->>'bypass_diode_status') <> 'normal'

SELECT ROUND(AVG(o.maintcost::numeric / (17520.0 / o.mtbfh::numeric))) AS mean_repair_cost FROM operational_metrics o JOIN plant_record pr ON pr.snapkey = o.snapops JOIN plants p ON p.sitekey = pr.sitetie JOIN panel_models pm ON pm.modkey = p.modhook WHERE LOWER(pm.pnlkind) = 'hjt' AND o.mtbfh IS NOT NULL AND o.mtbfh > 0

note: soil_loss_pct max is 14.99, so the count is 0.

answer: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT pr.sitetie) FROM plant_record pr JOIN electrical_performance e ON e.snaplink = pr.snapkey JOIN operational_metrics o ON o.snapops = pr.snapkey WHERE e.elec_perf_snapshot->'energy_yield'->>'performance_ratio' IS NOT NULL AND o.mtbfh IS NOT NULL AND o.mttrh IS NOT NULL AND o.mtbfh + o.mttrh > 0 AND (e.elec_perf_snapshot->'energy_yield'->>'performance_ratio')::numeric < 0.75 AND 1 - o.mttrh::numeric / (o.mtbfh::numeric + o.mttrh::numeric) < 0.95
note: Availability from MTBF/MTTR is never below 0.95 (nor is availability_pct below 95), so 0.

answer: SELECT (elec_perf_snapshot->'power'->>'power_now_w')::numeric * (1 - (elec_perf_snapshot->'power'->>'power_loss_w')::numeric / ((elec_perf_snapshot->'power'->>'power_now_w')::numeric + (elec_perf_snapshot->'power'->>'power_loss_w')::numeric)) AS effective_power_w FROM electrical_performance WHERE LOWER(snaplink) = 'pv945724'
